summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration testing of BrandRoot Salon & Spa luxury marketing site. Verified home page hero + all major sections (categories, testimonials, featured services), all 6 navigation routes (both desktop and mobile hamburger menu), packages page (Silver/Gold/Platinum, Most Popular badge, Buy Now WhatsApp deep-links, FAQ accordion), gallery (filter + lightbox + Escape to close), contact form validation + success, appointment form validation (empty/invalid email+phone) + success + WhatsApp confirm link with details, floating WhatsApp/phone/back-to-top buttons, and no horizontal overflow at 320px & 390px. No console errors observed on any page.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav data-testid values in review_request (e.g. nav-link-about, nav-link-services, nav-link-contact) do NOT match actual DOM. Actual IDs are derived from labels: nav-link-about-us, nav-link-our-services, nav-link-our-packages, nav-link-contact-us, nav-link-gallery, nav-link-home. Testing worked with the actual IDs, but consider stabilising testids by using the route path (e.g. nav-link-about) rather than the display label so future label changes don't break selectors.

AppointmentPage `set` handler uses functional-less form update (setForm({...form, [k]: e.target.value})) referencing possibly stale state — safe for single-field per keystroke but consider useCallback + functional updater for large forms.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend flows validated end-to-end against the public preview URL. Desktop nav testids follow the pattern nav-link-{label-lowercased-with-hyphens} where label = displayed label (e.g. 'About Us' -> nav-link-about-us). Mobile equivalents use mobile-nav-link-{same}. Lightbox closes on Escape. Contact and Appointment success panels appear (contact-success-message, appointment-success-message). Floating WA/phone/back-to-top all wired with correct hrefs and testids. No horizontal overflow at 320/390. No console errors.
